definitions.full: H5169. nachats [ נָחַץ ] verb urge (?), whence (si vera lectio); — Qal Passive participle ( active Participle in u , according to Ba NB 175 ), נָחוּץ הַמֶּל֛ח דְּבַד 1Sam 21:9 the king's business was urgent ( ᵐ5 κατὰ σπουδήν , A κατασπεῦδον ). (Thes compare Arabic ursit instititgue rogando [Kam Frey]); text dubious; HPS נָאוֺץ (from אוץ ), > נחושׁ . נחר (probably onomatopoetic √ of following; compare Assyrian na—îru , nostril ; Arabic snort , nostril ; Ethiopic snort ; Syriac id. , nostril ; נְחִירָא ᵑ7 id. ; also Late Hebrew Pi`el snort ). — נָחַר Jer 6:29 etc., see I. חרר .
